name: pipeline-calculators
description: Pipe-Up pipeline calculators for field and office hydrostatic test planning, wall thickness sizing, pipe volume and displacement, natural gas flow, ASME B31G remaining-strength estimates, sideboom spanning and lift load, and field bending strain limits in Canada and the United States.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test lib/hydrostatic.test.ts lib/wall-thickness.test.ts lib/pipe-volume.test.ts lib/gas-flow.test.ts lib/b31g.test.ts lib/sideboom-span-lift.test.ts lib/field-bending-limits.test.ts
scripts.verify: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-hydro.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-wall.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-volume.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-gas-flow.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-b31g.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-sideboom.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-field-bending.ts
